title: What Happens When You Crack Your Knuckles

sections.name: What Happens When You Crack Your Knuckles
lines: That pop you hear when you crack your knuckles? It's not your bones.
Each finger joint sits inside a capsule of slippery fluid that keeps it gliding.
When you pull or bend the joint, the space inside gets bigger, and the pressure drops.
Gas dissolved in that fluid suddenly forms a bubble. That's the pop.
That's why you can't crack the same knuckle again straight away. It takes about twenty minutes to reset.
And arthritis? One doctor cracked the knuckles on only one hand, for more than sixty years.
Neither hand got arthritis. He even won a prize for it.
